🎵 **Afrobeats Virtual Festival — Streaming Infrastructure Update** 🎵

Hey team! Quick coordination update as we kick off the Music Festival Tech Stack project:

📌 **Channel Focus**: #engineering topic has been updated to reflect our current priority — building out the streaming infrastructure for the virtual Afrobeats festival.

🔍 **CDN Research**: I searched our message/file history for prior CDN discussions (queries: 'CDN', 'content delivery network', 'Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai', 'edge server/latency/bandwidth') and found *no existing threads* on CDN solutions in this workspace. We'll need to start this research fresh rather than build on past discussion — flagging this so we don't waste time hunting for something that isn't there.

👤 **Robert Chen — Role Check**: Robert Chen (robert@neuroflow.ai) does not have a formal 'title' set in his Slack profile, and he's currently not a member of #engineering — he's active in #core-infra, where he's been coordinating GPU cluster cost/performance work (budget calls, task delegation, syncing the team). That behavior lines up with an engineering-lead function, but I'd recommend getting explicit confirmation of his official title/scope before finalizing the streaming infra leadership assignment. Note: there's also a *Robert Walsh* in this workspace (admin, in #engineering) — different person, easy to mix up!

⚡ **Łukasz Kowalski added**: Added Łukasz (performance optimization background — GPU scheduling/batching work visible in #core-infra) to this channel so he's looped into festival streaming infra planning.

📂 **Relevant channels found**: Besides #engineering/#frontend/#general, **#core-infra** (Infrastructure, K8s, AWS, on-call/incidents) looks directly relevant to our CDN/streaming infra work and already has Robert Chen, Łukasz Kowalski, Priya Sharma, and others engaged in related infra discussions.

Let's use this channel as home base for engineering coordination on the festival build-out.

🎵 **Afrobeats Virtual Festival — Streaming Infrastructure: Frontend Heads-Up** 🎵

Hi team — sharing a coordination update as we ramp up the Music Festival Tech Stack project (virtual Afrobeats festival streaming):

📌 #engineering's topic has been updated to reflect this is now the priority focus — worth keeping an eye on that channel for backend/streaming API details that'll affect our player UI, buffering states, and stream quality controls.

🔍 On the CDN front: no prior CDN-solution discussions were found in our Slack history, so infra/backend is starting that research now. We'll get an update once a CDN provider is selected, since that will affect player integration (video tag/HLS.js config, adaptive bitrate handling, etc.) on our end.

👥 Team note: Robert Chen and Łukasz Kowalski (performance optimization background) are coordinating the engineering/infra side in #engineering and #core-infra. If you need frontend-perf input synced with backend streaming work (e.g., player buffering, lazy loading for high concurrency), Łukasz is a good contact.

📂 Also flagging **#core-infra** as a channel worth watching if you want visibility into the underlying infra decisions (CDN, edge, K8s) that will shape what the frontend needs to support.

Will keep this channel posted as streaming infra decisions land that affect the client side.

📢 **Project Update: Virtual Afrobeats Festival — Streaming Infrastructure** 📢

Hi all — quick company-wide update on the Music Festival Tech Stack project:

🎯 **What's happening**: We're standing up the streaming infrastructure for our virtual Afrobeats festival. #engineering's channel topic now reflects this as the current focus area, so head there for technical coordination.

🔍 **CDN research**: We looked for prior internal discussions on CDN solutions to build on, but found none in our history — the team is starting this evaluation from scratch (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai-type options for global low-latency delivery).

👥 **Team involved**:
• Robert Chen — active in infrastructure coordination (#core-infra); role/title confirmation is in progress since his Slack profile doesn't have a formal title set.
• Łukasz Kowalski — added to #engineering for his performance optimization experience, directly relevant to streaming performance tuning.

📂 **Channels relevant to this project**: #engineering (primary hub), #frontend (player/client-side work), and #core-infra (K8s/AWS/infrastructure — likely where CDN and edge delivery decisions will be made).

We'll keep posting updates here as major milestones land. Let us know if you'd like to be looped into specific workstreams!
